grounding.states: Ontario Structured Psychotherapy is free and publicly funded CBT for adults with depression or anxiety-related concerns
grounding.from: Free, publicly funded option: Ontario Structured Psychotherapy (OSP) — adults with depression and anxiety-related concerns can get free, publicly funded cognitive-behavioural therapy through OSP

grounding.states: No health card or family doctor is needed, and you can self-refer
grounding.from: No Ontario health card or primary care provider is required, and self-referrals are accepted
To use it, find your local network at ontariohealth.ca/osp and fill out the referral form

grounding.states: It is available virtually, by phone or in person

value.answer: Hi, glad you reached out. The free option I'd try first is Ontario Structured Psychotherapy. It's publicly funded CBT for adults dealing with depression or anxiety. You don't need a health card or a family doctor, you can refer yourself at ontariohealth.ca/osp, and sessions can be by phone, video or in person. If you want something cheaper and quicker to start, Radcliffe Psychotherapy Clinic gives 5 free sessions with student therapists, and CMHA Toronto is at (416) 789-7957. Psychology Today's Canadian directory also has therapists taking new clients at low cost. Prices and openings may have changed since these pages were last updated, so check before you book. What are you hoping to work on? That would help me point you to the right fit.
